verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a dedicated Memory Export feature producing structured, machine-readable exports via customizable Pydantic schemas, plus CLI and REST/OpenAPI access and a fully self-hostable open-source stack, giving platform engineers multiple portable, non-lock-in export paths. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that exports round-trip into another store, and no explicit bulk/full-dump export format spec beyond the schema-based export.
